{{Top|leg}}
'''Neolene''' was a material. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Mirta Gev]] used neolene straps to affix a sheath containing a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] to her [[Limb/Legends|calf]] while serving the corporation [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] at the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Base Prime]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. During an altercation with Gev, the escaped GET captive [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] stole her vibroknife and slashed the neolene straps.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
 
==Behind the scenes==
Neolene was referenced in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
